# FileUpload

A file-selection surface with browsing, drag-and-drop, selected-file removal and validation feedback. Use its callbacks to receive files and perform uploads in the host; selecting a file does not upload it. Choosing a file the host has just removed, or the same file again, calls the callbacks again: FileUpload keeps no selection in its file input. That input has no `name`, so a `<form>` submits no files from it.

- **Import:** `import { DropZone, FileUpload } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-fileupload--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { FileUpload, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function FileUploadExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-96">
        <FileUpload
          accept=".jpg,.png,.pdf"
          helperText="Images and PDFs up to 8 MB."
          label="Attachment"
          maxSize={8 * 1024 * 1024}
        />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## FileUpload

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `FileUploadProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange">`.

- `accept`: `string`, optional.
- `browseLabel`: `string`, optional.

  The words that open the picker: "Click to upload" on the drop area,
  "Choose file" on `variant="button"`, where a product passes its own,
  such as "Add logo".

- `changeLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Change"`.

  The Change button's words in `preview="image"`, "Change" by default; its
  spoken name adds the file's name, as the remove button's does.

- `description`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `dropLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"or drag and drop"`.
- `emptyDescription`: `string`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `maxFiles`: `number`, optional.

  How many files one pick or drop may hold: more, and FileUpload refuses
  them with `tooManyFilesLabel`. One by default, none with `multiple`.

- `maxSize`: `number`, optional.

  The largest file, in bytes: a larger one is refused with `tooLargeLabel`.

- `multiple`: `boolean`, optional.

  Whether the picker takes several files. Unset, it does when `maxFiles` is
  over 1; `false` keeps it to one file whatever `maxFiles` says, so a
  product with its own count check can pass `maxFiles={Infinity}` and
  still open a one-file picker (GAP-258).

- `tooManyFilesLabel`: `(maxFiles: number) => string`, optional, default `defaultTooManyFilesLabel`.

  The refusal of a pick or drop past `maxFiles`, in the product's words
  (GAP-258): "Select up to 3 files." by default.

- `tooLargeLabel`: `(fileName: string, maxSize: string) => string`, optional, default `defaultTooLargeLabel`.

  The refusal of a file over `maxSize`, given its name and the limit as
  written ("2 MB"): "plan.pdf exceeds 2 MB." by default.

- `notImageLabel`: `(fileName: string) => string`, optional, default `defaultNotImageLabel`.

  The refusal of a file that is not an image, in `preview="image"`:
  "plan.pdf is not an image." by default.

- `inputRef`: `React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>`, optional.

  The hidden file input itself, for a product that has to reach it (a
  test's `setInputFiles`, a form library). The component's own ref stays
  its box: moving it would break every caller holding one (GAP-258).

- `onFileSelect`: `(file: File) => void`, optional.
- `onFilesChange`: `(files: File[]) => void`, optional.
- `preview`: `"image"`, optional.

  `"image"`: one image, shown once chosen as an avatar-sized thumbnail with
  Change and Remove in place of the drop area (GAP-270). It holds one file,
  takes `image/*` unless `accept` says otherwise, and turns away a file
  that is not an image, as it turns away one over `maxSize`.

- `variant`: `"dropzone" | "button"`, optional, default `"dropzone"`.

  What the visitor picks with (GAP-274). `dropzone`, the default, is the
  dashed drop area. `button` is a Button-sized trigger, an outline Button
  with the upload icon and `browseLabel` as its words ("Add logo"), for a
  field with no room for a drop area, such as a logo beside a client's
  name. It picks and validates as the drop area does, takes a file
  dropped on it, and lists what was chosen, or shows `preview="image"`'s
  thumbnail, in the same way.

- `previewAlt`: `string`, optional.

  The thumbnail's alt text in `preview="image"`; the file's name by default.

- `removeLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Remove file"`.
- `status`: `FieldStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `value`: `File[]`, optional.
- `defaultFiles`: `File[]`, optional.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### FieldStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type FieldStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
